root_cause.text: Missing zero-initialization of padding fields (nduseropt_pad1, nduseropt_pad2, nduseropt_pad3) in the nduseroptmsg struct when constructing an RTM_NEWNDUSEROPT netlink message in ndisc_ra_useropt(), allowing uninitialized kernel stack memory to be leaked to userspace.
root_cause.evidence: The patch explicitly adds `ndmsg->nduseropt_pad1 = 0; ndmsg->nduseropt_pad2 = 0; ndmsg->nduseropt_pad3 = 0;` after setting the other fields, and the commit message states that "the nduseroptmsg struct has three padding fields that are never zeroed and can leak kernel data".
